text: The next tale begins decades after the hero of the First Tale slew the wizard Mondain...
Peaceful years passed slowly, making that dark age seem unreal.
Folk forgot fear and pain as the realm grew, thriving.
During those peaceful decades, time travel was discovered, greatly advancing the realm's culture and science.
At times, rumors spread of the evil wizard Mondain's return, or of a disciple wielding terrible magic...
Each time, brave souls searched Mondain's ruined keep and found no trace of evil.
Yet unseen by all, that evil disciple grew in power and unleashed monsters upon the world.
Too late, folk saw it: monster cries filled the land, and the nightmare returned!
Driven to the brink of despair, the people beheld a witch in glittering jewels.
She was Minax, heir to Mondain's dark sorcery, wielding power even greater than her master's.
Her terrible magic tore time and space apart.
People knew terror like never before, and shadows of evil crept even into virtuous hearts.
Without her lifting a finger, people turned against each other in strife and harm.
Humanity marched toward ruin, until the great cataclysm of 2111 shattered Earth, turning it into a world ruled by evil...
When her triumph seemed certain, humanity placed its last hope in time travel...
By crossing time to slay Minax, the root of this evil, they could erase the history of their doom!
Thus, a hero was summoned to brave the perils of time travel and defeat Minax.
Before the Time Doors linking the ages, Lord British and all living souls gave heartfelt thanks to the departing hero.
Lord British spoke to the hero:
Never forget! The hopes of this world and all across countless ages are ever with thee!
